textbookText: Introduction and objective, for optimal banking angle. ix) Theoretical background, understanding of physics to enhance behind the banking angle and the forces involved such as centripetal force, gravitational force and the normal reaction force. Data collection methodology: 1. Mark the edge of the track using a chalk or some color. 2. Take two points on the arc marked, draw tangents and normal on the tangents at the points so that the normal meets at a point, giving rise to the radius, called the centre of the circle. (It can also be done by visual inspection or using a map/blueprint if available or by GPS device, smartphones or, using a mapping software.) 3. Measure the radius of the possible circle. x) Take a specified value of velocity Calculation steps and results: Use θ = tan-1v2 rg Validation and discussion. Conclusion and recommendations. References and appendices.
